title: Wen Yang Rides Through an Army; Sima Shi Dies of a Tumour
summary: Guanqiu Jian revolts at Shouchun. His young officer Wen Yang rides alone into Sima Shi's camp by night, kills his way through, comes out, and then turns and does it again — and Sima Shi, who has recently had a tumour cut from behind his eye, bursts the wound in his agitation and dies of it within days.
Sima Zhao inherits everything, and refuses an imperial order to hand the army over.
history: Historical, eye and all. Wen Yang's ride is one of the best-attested feats of individual arms in the whole period.

pins.note: Rides through an army, twice, in one night.
Bursts the wound behind his eye, and dies of it.
Inherits, and refuses to give the army back.
Sends the order that is refused.
